name: @aoc-enterprise/governed-authority
description: Enterprise-owned, action-neutral vocabulary for governed authority state: the right-scoped authority position AOC recognizes an actor as holding, the basis by which it arose, the append-only transition that moves it, the holder-bound representative authority by which one party may exercise another's position, the pre-execution reservation and post-execution encumbrance that account for how much of it stands committed, and the two coverage questions a governed action's authority check asks. Pure data only: no store, no resolver implementation, no persistence, no policy engine, no orchestration, no claim of legal ownership, and no claim of legal agency.
